group_min.note: No minimum group size is published. Alberta Parks has used a minimum of four on other trails in bear seasons (trip research), so check the trail report before going.

age_band.note: The plan's figures (11.3 km and 675 m, from blogs) fit the 10-12 ceilings, but the final gully is close to 400 m in just over 1 km on loose ground: from 13 (our judgement).

suitability.kid_note: Past Rawson Lake, a steep, slippery gully climbs to an exposed ridge. Not for children; Rawson Lake itself is the family turnaround.
